text:
hema: Quick flag from last night's q6b-int4 bring-up on Dedicated — we're seeing a reproducible drop for numeric/table-heavy docs in deid-docs-longtail-v3. Looks like exact-number preservation and citation spans are affected. Need targeted curation + microgolden.

tomas: yikes. can you paste the eval + which slices?

hema: pasted run below (full eval attached to ticket ML-4210):

```
$ rbin eval --model q6b-1.2-int4 --dataset deid-docs-longtail-v3 --slices numeric_tables,citation_spans,long_docs
Exact-match (numbers): 86.0% (-6.4% vs fp16)
Citation-overlap: 78.3% (-5.1%)
Hallucination-rate: 9.5% (+4.2%)
High-severity-hallu: 4.1% (+2.7%)
Latency p50: 235ms
```

nora: interesting. any changes to KV/ongoing batching config? could be per-layer quant artifacts (layernorm/attn) or per-kernel weight layout.

hema: serving config was default for the bring-up. I also tried a quick ablate: disabling kv-cache -> exact-match improved +0.6%, so small effect. The big delta correlates with attention quant paths.

rahul: can we treat this like a targeted quality regression? My recommendation: assemble a focused microgolden set for numeric fidelity + citation preservation. Suggested size: 200 gold core (long docs >=1000 tokens) + 100 table-heavy rows + 150 adversarial paraphrases. 3 labelers per item, plus a validator.

tomas: sounds right. also capture provenance and a deterministic fingerprint so future drift shows up quickly. add fields: source_uri, capture_ts, md5_text, shingle_hash.

nora: I'll run a per-layer quant sweep today. plan to try: keep layernorm & attn in fp16, dense in int4; and also test kernel permutations. Example command: 

```
rbin quant-sweep --model q6b-1.2 --bits 4 --layer-exceptions layernorm,attn --kernels aten,flash,fast_attn --permute none,block --kv-cache on,off --eval deid-docs-longtail-v3 --save-logs ML-4210/logs
```

labeler-bot: New ticket ML-4210 created: "q6b-int4: numeric/citation regression on deid-docs-longtail-v3". Labeling plan attached.

hema: microgolden schema (proposal):
- 200 long documents (>=1000 tokens) sampled from RAG sessions (deid-filtered)
- 100 table-heavy examples where model must reproduce numeric cells
- 150 synthetic adversarial paraphrases targeting numeric paraphrase (e.g., "3.5%" -> "three and a half percent")
- 3 independent labelers per example + 1 validator; label fields: exact_number_match (yes/no), hallucination_flag (yes/no), hallucination_note (short span), citation_link_preserved (yes/no), severity 0-3
- sampling procedure: recent 30-day traffic, prefer docs with multi-cell tables and inline citations

rahul: assembly/dedupe plan: sample 1.2k candidates -> token-shingle fuzzy dedupe (3-gram) -> fingerprinting -> produce 450 candidates -> labeler queue final 450 -> labelers confirm top 450 -> validator picks final 450 -> finalize 450 then curate down to 450/350/200 split depending on label consistency. I'll include provenance fields and export CSV for console import.

tomas: slightly worried about cost. prefer final microgolden ~350 rather than 600. recommend labeler redundancy only on the top 350.

hema: fine. let's target 350 final microgolden with the following breakdown: 200 long docs, 100 table-heavy, 50 synthetic adversarials. 3 labelers each; validator on disagree cases.

nora: sweep plan + next steps: run the quant variants, if one variant recovers numeric EM -> we either pin per-layer exceptions or forbid that kernel for q6b on Dedicated. if no single variant recovers, try per-weight mixed precision (int4 with 8-bit scale for attention matrices). Will attach results to ML-4210 and include kernel traces.

labeler-bot: Labeling batch LB-8010 created for ML-4210. Estimated first-pass ETA 72 hrs.

rahul: I'll start candidate extraction now and push dedupe artifacts to ML-4210/artifacts. Will run fuzzyhash with shingle-size=3 and threshold=0.85.

hema: ops copy for labelers (short):
"Objective: confirm numbers and citation spans are preserved by the model output. Steps: (1) check the output matches source numeric values exactly (for tables, check each cell); (2) if model adds numbers not in source mark 'hallucination' and provide smallest evidence span; (3) for inline citations confirm link text and citation id preserved; (4) mark severity 0-3 and add short rationale. Escalate unmasked PII to privacy-ops"

tomas: console: add a tiny dashboard card "numeric-exact-match (deid-docs-longtail-v3)" showing EM rate on golden & production slices + trend line. Also add an alert if EM drops >2% week-over-week.

hema: I'll file the console card ticket and attach the sample promptset once rahul pushes the artifacts.

nora: running sweep now. will post logs/backtraces to ML-4210 and ping when a candidate kernel is flagged.

rahul: dedupe started. will ping when LB-8010 gets filled.

hema: thanks all. action items: (1) nora quant-per-layer sweep + logs to ML-4210, (2) rahul candidate assembly + dedupe + populate LB-8010, (3) labelers start LB-8010, (4) hema file console card and update Optimize profile suggestions if a stable int4 recipe emerges. ping if blocked. :white_check_mark:
